[[Marga Coast]] | collector = y | dye trader = y | henchman = y | merchant = y | skill trainer = y | storage = y | pic1 = [[Image:Yohlon Haven world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:Yohlon Haven inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view inside }} [[Yohlon Haven]] is a central gathering area for the traders and farmers of the surrounding settlements and villages. This is the first [[location]] on the [[Elona|Elonian]] mainland (in the [[region]] of [[Kourna]]) that a character will arrive at after [[Istan]]. {{Quotation|game| The hub of social and business gatherings, Yohlon Haven is located at a major viaduct and, along with water, disseminates gossip, news, and informal trade among the farmers in the area. Such gatherings have made the station moderately wealthy and travelers will be comfortable here. }} ==Getting there== Completion of the [[Consulate Docks]] [[mission]] is the only way to get here and, consequentially, to progress along the [[Storyline of Nightfall|Nightfall storyline]]. ==Exits== *[[Arkjok Ward]] (east) *[[Marga Coast]] (northwest) ==Quests available== *[[Sunspear Modiki]] **[[Hunted!]] {{quest icon|primary}} *[[Zudash Dejarin]] **[[The Dejarin Estate]] **[[Family Ties (Nightfall quest)|Family Ties]] ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== =====Collectors===== *{{x}} 10 [[Apida]] ([[collector]] for 1 [[Chunk of Drake Flesh]]) *{{x}} 10 [[Yajide]] (collector for 3 [[Mandragor Root]]s) =====Henchmen===== :''(all level 20)'' *{{w}} [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Kihm]] (Healer) *{{mo}} [[Mhenlo]] (Healer) *{{n}} [[Eve]] (Blood) *{{me}} [[Odurra]] (Domination) *{{e}} [[Cynn]] (Fire) *{{e}} [[Herta]] (Earth) *{{p}} [[Sogolon]] (Motivation) *{{d}} [[Gehraz]] (Holy) =====Other services===== *{{x}} 20 [[Ahleri]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 20 [[Pohgri]] ([[dye trader]]) *{{x}} 10 [[Medando]] ([[skill trainer]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) ===Other allies=== *{{x}} 10 [[Herbalist Makala]] *{{x}} 10 [[Zudash Dejarin]] *{{x}} 3 [[Sunspear Modiki]] *{{x}} 10 [[Kournan Noble]]s *{{x}} 10 [[Kournan Peasant]]s *{{x}} 2 [[Kournan Child]]ren ==Notes== * Complete exploration of this outpost adds approximately 0.3% towards the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title. {{Towns and outposts in Kourna}}
